# Token Dashboard for DeepSeek Harness
`@asun-labs/dsh-plugin-token-dashboard` is a DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin that reads the host's va
lidated live and persisted session corpus and generates a self-contained offline HTML token dashboar
dated live and persisted session corpus and generates a self-contained offline HTML token dashboard.
## Features

- Exact provider-reported input, output, cache-read, and cache-write token accounting
- Daily volume

, 24-hour activity, model share, and KPI views
- Workspace → session → request drilldown
- Interacti

ve 1/7/30-day and all-history windows
- Light/dark theme stored only in the browser
- One local HTML

file with no external scripts, fonts, requests, or telemetry
- Fork-aware accounting that excludes
inherited event prefixes
## Requirements

- Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0`
- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.7` prerelease line

## Configuration
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- `fileName` must be a plain `.html` filename. The plugin never writes outside the active workspace.
- `readConcurrency` is an integer from 1 through 32.
## Privacy
The plugin reads session snapshots through the public `sessionQuery` service. It does not scan stora
ge internals, upload logs, or make network requests. Generated HTML contains usage metadata, workspa
ce paths, session titles, and model names; review it before sharing.
## Attribution and licensing
The product idea was inspired by fuyi-git/token-dashboard. That repository did not include a redistr
ibution license when this implementation was created, so this project is an independent TypeScript i
mplementation and does not copy its Python or HTML source.
